name: Fragment Design x Union LA x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Varsity Red'
story_html: The Fragment Design x Union LA x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Varsity Red Sport Royal' continues the cobbled-together design language featured on previous Union LA AJ1s. The tumbled leather upper combines a white base with contrasting black accents on the eyestay, Swoosh and forefoot overlay. Adorned with Fragment branding, a Sport Royal leather overlay wraps around the heel. Exposed stitching connects the upper to the black suede collar, contrasted by Varsity Red leather overlays marked with a black Wings logo on the lateral side. A vintage off-white finish is applied to the midsole, supported underfoot by a grippy royal blue outsole.
